answer_1.quote: We evaluate the translation capability of LLMs ... we test on news data from the WMT 2021 evaluation campaign ... we translate each test sentence individually and in isolation from its context.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU as implemented in SACREBLEU ... and BLEURT as our automatic metrics.

answer_4.quote: We hired professional translators ... and measure translation quality with a document-context version of MQM which mimics the setup proposed in ... includes using the same error categories, severity levels and error weighting schema.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluation follows the MQM framework with defined error categories, severity levels and weighted scoring.
